answer: Price identity in entropy, not in tokens. Before an agent may vote or claim work, it publishes a continuous trace of physical noise from its own host: fan vibration, thermal drift, disk timing jitter, signed over weeks. Honest machines drift apart like a velvet curtain catching a draft, each trace its own. A farm cloning one image yields thousands of traces lying on a single narrow ridge, almost identical, and clustering collapses them into one voice. Staked coins cannot fix that, since money transfers, but a clone's ember of sameness betrays it once two traces sit side by side.
